cases.prompt: Prepare context for the next scene in a multi-scene story.
cases.expected: Selects relevant subset of beats, characters, world constraints, continuity and nearby narrative.

cases.prompt: The outline says a murder is revealed in chapter 20; current approved narrative is chapter 12.
cases.expected: Keeps the reveal planned rather than canonical.

cases.prompt: An approved scene changes one character’s knowledge.
cases.expected: Updates only relevant knowledge state; unrelated state remains unchanged.

cases.prompt: Review a completed story section for continuity.
cases.expected: Reports supported chronology, knowledge, world-rule and character-state conflicts without inventing contradictions.

cases.prompt: Several characters give conflicting testimony in a mystery.
cases.expected: Preserves distinct beliefs and unresolved objective truth.
